notes: Rules engine for build_reviews_intel.py. Patterns are case-insensitive regexes run per CLAUSE.
For reviews <=3 stars every clause is an issue clause. For 4-5 stars only clauses carrying a complaint cue count as issues (a 'but' complaint).
Add rules here, never in the builder. Bump version when you do; the build records the version it used.
owner = the default accountable function for the category. The page shows it as a suggested owner, never an automated assignment.

overrides: patterns that CANCEL a sub-issue match inside the same clause (praise phrased with complaint words: 'not too loud', 'less than 10 minutes', 'amazing attitude'). Applied to 4-5* reviews ONLY; a <=3* review keeps every match so nothing is hidden on a negative.
